_note: Enforces each new swing strategy's declared market-trend tag (see each strategy's own config _note) against trader.core.trend_structure's UPTREND/SIDEWAYS/DOWNTREND state machine - the price-action course's own swing-structure method (HH+HL / LH+LL after 2+ swings, break of market structure -> SIDEWAYS), NOT trader.core.market_trend's separate IBD-style VD-day/FTD engine (that module is untouched and still used by scripts/market_trend.py). A strategy with no entry below is NOT gated at all - tagging is opt-in, so weekly_rsi_sma20 (untagged) is unaffected. Enabled by default: with no tagged strategy enabled this is a no-op (every candidate's strategy name misses the map and passes straight through), so it's safe to leave on.
